description: Deterministic funnel audit from OSM Alps bulk pipeline to publication candidates. Clarified semantics for mountain-match stages.

semantics.primarySummit: The summit with highest confidence/lowest distance used as the route's primary summit
semantics.atLeastOneSummit: Route has >=1 associated summit meeting criteria
semantics.everySummit: ALL summits associated with the route (via peak associations) meet criteria
semantics.selectedPublicationSummit: The single summit selected for publication (first CONFIRMED)
semantics.allRouteAssociatedSummits: All summits linked to the route in the peak association data

funnelStages.description: All OSM relations with route=hiking in the Alps extract
Successfully reconstructed route geometry from relation members
Routes classified by semantic type (summit_route, local_hike, etc.)
Only summit_route semantic type accepted for publication
Routes with at least one CONFIRMED summit association (semanticAssociationCrossTab CONFIRMED count)
funnelStages.note: Per semanticAssociationCrossTab, all 2780 summit_route routes have >=1 CONFIRMED summit. Routes with multiple confirmed: 90.

funnelStages.description: Primary summit (selected for publication) has EXACT_MOUNTAIN_MATCH classification
funnelStages.note: Per semanticAssociationCrossTab, all CONFIRMED summit associations are EXACT_MOUNTAIN_MATCH. This checks the selected publication summit only.

funnelStages.description: Phase 7 eligibility audit - AUTO_IMPORT_READY only (requires EXACT_MOUNTAIN_MATCH for EVERY summit on route)

rejectionReasons.EXACT_MATCH_NOT_ALL_SUMMITS: Routes with multiple summits where not all are EXACT_MOUNTAIN_MATCH (90 routes have multiple confirmed summits)
rejectionReasons.VALIDATION_ERRORS: Staging contract validation failures (geometry, provenance, etc.)
rejectionReasons.WARNINGS_AUDIT_EVIDENCE: Route has warning flags or audit evidence

funnelStages.note: Phase 8 validateStagingContract with requireExactMountainMatches=true requires EXACT_MOUNTAIN_MATCH for EVERY summit in confirmedSummits array, not just the primary summit.

funnelStages.description: Routes that have been visually reviewed and VISUALLY_APPROVED
Routes passing Phase 10 gate: VISUALLY_APPROVED, EXACT_MOUNTAIN_MATCH (primary), CONFIRMED summit, no warnings
Publication candidates not already ACTIVE in production

summary.bottleneck: PHASE8_STAGING_ELIGIBILITY: Only 46 of 2780 summit_route routes pass all staging validations. The primary filters are: EXACT_MOUNTAIN_MATCH required for EVERY summit on route (90 routes have multiple confirmed summits), AUTO_IMPORT_READY eligibility, no validation errors, admin boundary ASSIGNED, and no warnings/audit evidence.
